name: deteccion-anomalias-perros
description: Tesis UPC: detección temprana de anomalías conductuales y fisiológicas en perros (CNN-LSTM + Firebase).

scripts.build: npm --prefix functions run build && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test:unit: vitest run functions/test/unit shared/test simulator/test/unit web/test
scripts.test:rules: firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-perros-tesis "vitest run tests/rules"
scripts.test:functions: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-perros-tesis "vitest run functions/test/integration --testTimeout 20000"
scripts.test:sim: npm --prefix functions run build && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project demo-perros-tesis "vitest run simulator/test/integration"
